source.title: Understanding the Ruminant Animal Digestive System | Mississippi State University Extension Service

claims.fact: 牛等真正反刍动物为一个胃、四个分室，不是四个互不相关的独立胃。
claims.quote: have one stomach with four compartments: the rumen, reticulum, omasum, and abomasums.

claims.fact: 瘤胃与网胃中的微生物发酵并分解植物材料，不能概括为前三部分只贮藏而完全不消化。
claims.quote: These microbes ferment and break down plant cell walls into their carbohydrate fractions

claims.fact: 反刍包括食物回到口腔进一步咀嚼并与唾液混合，完整生理路线不由童话中的第一第二编号图替代。
claims.quote: forage and other feedstuffs are forced back to the mouth for further chewing and mixing with saliva.
